audience: food and beverage manufacturers that run their food safety and quality programs in SafetyChain

useCases.title: Find non-compliant records
useCases.text: The AI searches the records submitted in a date range for non-compliant ones, filtered by form, location or resource, and reads the field values of a record with each field's compliance result.

useCases.title: Review open CAPAs and their tasks
useCases.text: The AI searches corrective and preventive actions by status, location or severity, and for one CAPA shows its details, due dates and tasks with their assignees.

useCases.title: Trace what operators entered for a lot
useCases.text: The AI finds the records that carry an identifier such as a lot number and reads their field values: value, unit, target, minimum, maximum and compliance.

useCases.title: Size a period's record activity
useCases.text: The AI summarizes the records of a date range: the first and last date, and how many forms, locations, resources and users are involved.

useCases.title: Look up suppliers, items and forms
useCases.text: The AI lists the suppliers, items and forms of the tenant by name, with ids and enabled flags, and opens one for its details.

useCases.title: Follow a CAPA's history and linked records
useCases.text: The AI reads a CAPA's history, its comments and events, and the records linked to it, to explain how the action developed.
